changes.comment: Rename the harness ledger store to a repository: `LedgerStore`/`LedgerStoreShape`/`LedgerStoreFailure` are now `LedgerRepository`/`LedgerRepositoryShape`/`LedgerRepositoryFailure`, `FileLedgerStoreLive` is `FileLedgerRepositoryLive`, and the service key is `@rivus/agent-kit/harness/LedgerRepository/v1`; a save over a stale revision now fails with the tagged error `{ _tag: "RevisionConflict", scope, expected, stored }` instead of a failure of reason `revision-mismatch`. The file ledger repository passes the aggregate-repository conformance suite from `/testing/effect`.
